audit.why: Chart in both layers reads Sylas / Skill / Skill / Skill / Sejuani / Skill / Skill, matching the packet chart and the mirror audit exactly. Sylas 50.57% over 265 games supports an even read with a Sejuani level 6.

audit.whatIsWrong: Arctic Assault's cooldown is written as 13 seconds in whys[0] and 'fifteen-second' in dosFull[2].d.
audit.why: Kit file: Arctic Assault is 18/16.5/15/13.5/12. Levels 1-3 of laning it is 18 to 15 seconds, not 13.
audit.corrected: 18s at rank 1 — the level 1 to 3 window is far longer than the page claims, which makes the poke phase better than advertised. Glacial Prison is 120s at rank 1 against Hijack's 80s.

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[1] says she can 'trigger Permafrost off any frost stack'. Permafrost only stuns a target at MAXIMUM Frost stacks.
audit.why: Riot text: 'Sejuani freezes and stuns an enemy champion that has maximum Frost stacks.' Permafrost's own 1.5s cooldown is irrelevant — the real gate is how fast Winter's Wrath fills the bar.
audit.corrected: Your window is the Winter's Wrath arcs before Frost caps. Once the bar is full, a landed Permafrost stops Abscond outright — a stun prevents the cast, so you cannot dash out of it. This restates the mirror's finding from your side.

audit.whatIsWrong: Fury of the North is never mentioned, and the page repeatedly tells you to 'land the slow'.
audit.why: Riot text: Frost Armor grants Armor and Magic Resist and immunity to slows, and persists a short time after she takes damage. Chain Lash's slow does nothing to her while it is up.
audit.corrected: Poke her for the chip, not the slow — while Frost Armor holds she is slow-immune and tankier than her item build reads. The passive also lets her shatter a stunned target for heavy magic damage, which is why her own Permafrost follow-up hurts so much.

audit.whatIsWrong: Sylas's E is called a 'chain stun' in wants.you[0], and tradeBad refers to 'no stun'.
audit.why: Riot's text for Abscond/Abduct is a dash with a recast pull; no hardCC flag. The mirror auditor removed the same phrasing without asserting the negative.
audit.corrected: Rewrote both to the mechanic Riot's text does support — the pull and the gap-close.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page tracks Arctic Assault as the only cooldown and gives it the wrong number.
audit.why: Permafrost at 1.5s is uncounterable as a cooldown but gated on stacks; Arctic Assault at 18s is the genuinely punishable one; Glacial Prison at 120s outlasts your Hijack by 40s at rank 1.
audit.corrected: Rewrote breakdown.cooldowns with all three real numbers.

audit.whatIsWrong: dontsFull[1] and dontsFull[2] bodies are copy-pasted boilerplate unrelated to their titles.
audit.why: Generator copy-paste — 'Get hit by Arctic Assault for free' is explained with a sentence about spent E charges.
audit.corrected: Rewrote both to match their titles: the knockup prevents casts, and Glacial Prison at 1300 range with an 80s Hijack means a fight a screen away is still yours.

edits.before: You have Q Chain Lash and she has no gap-close yet — poke with the crossing chains and auto-weave passive stacks while Arctic Assault sits on a 13-second cooldown.
edits.after: She has no gap-close yet and Arctic Assault is 18s at rank 1 — poke with Chain Lash, but Frost Armor makes her slow-immune out of combat, so the chip is the point, not the slow.

edits.before: With E online you can threaten the hook-into-stun but so can she trigger Permafrost off any frost stack — both sides are fishing for the same CC trade so it evens out.
edits.after: Permafrost only fires at MAXIMUM Frost stacks, so your window is the Winter's Wrath arcs before Frost caps — with E online you both fish in the same two seconds and it evens out.

edits.before: You open with Q Chain Lash before she has Arctic Assault — she cannot close the gap safely, so land the slow and auto-weave for free chip.
edits.after: You open with Chain Lash before she has Arctic Assault, but Frost Armor gives her slow immunity out of combat — the chip is free, the slow is not.

edits.before: Hook in with E2 after her Arctic Assault dash is on cooldown so she cannot disengage the chain stun
edits.after: Hook with E2 while Frost is short of max — Permafrost is a 1.5s cooldown but it needs full stacks first

edits.before: Stack Permafrost on you with Winter's Wrath autos then pop E stun to cancel your W cast mid-heal
edits.after: Cap your Frost stacks with Winter's Wrath, then Permafrost — a landed stun stops Abscond outright

edits.after: - Sejuani Arctic Assault: matchup-defining — 18s at rank 1, 650 range, and she has no kill threat while it is down. - Permafrost is 1.5s but needs max Frost, so the arcs are your window. - Glacial Prison is 120s against your 80s Hijack.

edits.after: Arctic Assault is 18s and stops on the first champion it hits — bait it, count it, then go.

edits.after: Sejuani burns Arctic Assault on nothing — that is an 18-second invitation at rank 1.

edits.after: Track Sejuani’s Frost stacks: Permafrost only stuns at maximum stacks, and a landed stun stops Abscond, so go while it is short.

edits.after: Engaging with both E charges spent — no shield, no gap-close, and you are a melee mage inside her Q line.

edits.after: Glacial Prison is 1300 range and yours refreshes in 80s — a fight one screen over is still your fight.

notes: Two facts carried most of the value here. First, Permafrost needs MAXIMUM Frost stacks, not any stack — that turns the lane from 'she can stun you whenever' into 'you have the Winter's Wrath arcs', and it matches the mirror audit's finding. Second, Fury of the North grants slow immunity while Frost Armor holds, so every instruction on this page telling the player to 'land the slow' with Chain Lash was giving away the wrong reason to poke. Arctic Assault's cooldown was also wrong in two places (13s and 'fifteen-second'; it is 18s at rank 1). The mirror already established that a landed Permafrost stops Abscond — restated here from Sylas's side rather than re-derived.
